current_official_findings.verified: EPSG:27700 collection exposes real dtm_fn, tilename, flight dates, surveys, resolution, year, supplied and latest fields; live rows return actual DTM filenames and survey metadata.

current_official_findings.source: Time Stamped DTM OGC live items
current_official_findings.verified: Live rows expose lidar/dtm names, OS tile references, flight dates, resolution, transform, geoid, archive/supply/latest fields; transform/geoid are survey-lineage attributes rather than safe global constants.
Per-tile metadata declares EPSG:27700 British National Grid and EPSG:5701 Ordnance Datum Newlyn, earliest/latest flying dates, processing date, version, change reason and lineage.
Composite remains approximately 99 percent England at 1m, EPSG:27700, with source survey catalogue required to determine location-specific lineage.
